auto_storiesTHE PHILOSOPHY

Why did I launch OLOMWEB? And how do I create content?

For years I noticed a big gap in Arabic programming content: it is either only aimed at beginners covering HTML basics, or it lacks the real architectural practice used inside major global companies.

OLOMWEB (شبكة علوم) was founded to be the solid technical reference for anyone wanting to move from "writing simple code" to "professional software engineer". I treat every line of code and every video episode as official documentation of a real commercial project.
